name: coap_option_malformed
description: CoAP option parsing edge cases per RFC 7252 Section 3.1. Delta/length overflow, reserved values, option 0.

vectors.name: option_delta_13_extended_1byte
vectors.description: Delta 13 uses extended 1-byte format: actual_delta = 13 + ext_byte.

vectors.name: option_delta_14_extended_2byte
vectors.description: Delta 14 uses extended 2-byte format: actual_delta = 269 + uint16.

vectors.name: option_delta_15_reserved_reject
vectors.description: Delta 15 is reserved for payload marker (0xFF). MUST reject if used as option delta.

vectors.name: option_length_13_extended_1byte
vectors.description: Length 13 uses extended 1-byte format: actual_length = 13 + ext_byte.

vectors.name: option_length_14_extended_2byte
vectors.description: Length 14 uses extended 2-byte format: actual_length = 269 + uint16.

vectors.name: option_length_15_reserved_reject
vectors.description: Length 15 is reserved. MUST reject if used as option length.

vectors.name: option_0_if_match_zero_length
vectors.description: Option number 0 (If-Match) with zero length is valid per RFC 7252.

vectors.name: option_truncated_extended_delta
vectors.description: Extended delta (13) but no extension byte follows.

vectors.name: option_truncated_extended_length
vectors.description: Extended length (14) but only 1 byte follows instead of 2.

vectors.name: option_value_truncated
vectors.description: Option claims length 10 but only 5 bytes of value follow.

vectors.name: option_delta_overflow_reject
vectors.description: Delta extended value causes option number > 65535 (overflow).

vectors.name: payload_marker_without_payload
vectors.description: 0xFF payload marker with no bytes following is invalid.
